## Description

Combines GARCH marginal volatility forecasting with time-varying copulas (e.g., Clayton, Gumbel) to capture non-linear joint dependency structures for statistical arbitrage.

## Where it may fit

Non-linear asset co-movements, tail dependence shifts during market stress, complex multi-asset pairs.

## Vehicles

Statistical arbitrage hedge funds, quantitative equity market-neutral funds.

## Required data

High-frequency or daily returns series, marginal volatility models, copula parameter fitting historical windows.

## Caveats

Copula parameter estimation is computationally expensive and sensitive to window size selection.
